name: FocalPoint
summary: One movable dot on an uncropped picture sets the part every crop should keep. Not a crop rectangle or an image editor.
a11y: One named slider; its numeric value is the horizontal percentage, with both axes in aria-valuetext. The whole picture is the pointer target. Physical left/top coordinates do not mirror in RTL.

keys.action: move five percent; Shift + arrows: one percent. Home: centre. Pause or blur: commit.
